description: Reviewed structural mappings for legacy Test262 metadata. Prefer one esid alias, exact or semantic-boundary legacy metadata rule, or semantic-directory rule; an esid-qualified directory rule may redirect pinned informative metadata to its exact normative requirement. Exact source-hashed test overrides add the specific normative owner only for genuine ambiguity. Globs and fixture-family enumeration are forbidden.
